purpose: Master YURI artifact registry seed. This extends folder classification into durable docs, scripts, registries, reports, skills, runtime state, and generated artifacts.

rules.readByDefault: Only canonical anchors and context selectors may be read by default.
rules.protected: Protected paths are never read directly. Registering a protected path is a warning label, not read permission.
rules.creation: New durable artifacts must choose a storage rule before landing in the repo.
rules.supersession: Replacement artifacts must declare supersedes or supersededBy when applicable.

placementRules.storageRule: Operating policy, architecture, goals, guardrails, and durable plans live in _SYSTEM/docs/.
Runtime scripts and script tests live in _SYSTEM/Scripts/.
Registries, schemas, and machine-readable configuration live in _SYSTEM/config/.
Context selectors, packet docs, and context routing metadata live in _SYSTEM/context/.
Runtime state lives in _SYSTEM/state/ and is ignored unless explicitly promoted.
Generated or refreshed reports live in _SYSTEM/reports/.
Structured derived data lives in _SYSTEM/data/ and must point back to source docs/scripts.
Owned synthetic lab manifests and fixtures live in _SYSTEM/labs/.
Evidence and research sources live in _SYSTEM/research-archive/ before promotion.
Repo-local external tools live in _SYSTEM/tools/ and remain isolated from YURI source truth.
Agent recipes, role contracts, and assembly indexes live in .agents/. They reference canonical skills but do not contain skill bodies.
YURI-owned reusable skills live in root skills/.
Codex-specific skills live in .codex/skills/ and must not become global policy.
